title: Decision Columns as an Index: Interpretable Embeddings for Explainable Entity Matching and Search
abstract: arXiv:2611.27910v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Business data systems must determine whether records refer to the same entity and retrieve records satisfying requests whose decisive properties are implicit. As agents act on these records, both tasks require auditable reasons. Dense embeddings perform well but offer opaque coordinates, cannot be filtered by meaning, and require corpus re-encoding to add new properties. We propose interpretable embeddings built from decision columns: each column stores a decision model's calibrated answer to a natural-language question, with outcomes yes, no, or not stated. A record's embedding is its answers across an ordered set of questions. Similarity decomposes exactly into per-question contributions, and new questions add coordinates without altering existing ones.   On public product benchmarks, question-space retrieval matches dense candidate generation statistically in a retrieve-then-verify entity matcher, while providing exact explanations

translated_title: 决策列作为索引：面向可解释实体匹配与搜索的可解释嵌入
translated_abstract: 业务数据系统必须判断记录是否指向同一实体，并检索出满足那些决定性属性并不明确的请求的记录。随着智能体对这些记录执行操作，这两项任务都需要可审计的理由。稠密嵌入虽然表现良好，但其坐标不透明、无法按语义过滤，且要添加新属性就必须对整个语料库重新编码。我们提出由决策列构建的可解释嵌入：每一列存储一个决策模型对某个自然语言问题的校准答案，取值为“是”、“否”或“未提及”。一条记录的嵌入就是它在有序问题集上的一组答案。相似度可以精确分解为逐问题的贡献，而新增问题只会增加坐标、不会改变已有坐标。在公开的产品基准测试中，在“先检索后验证”的实体匹配器中，问题空间检索在统计意义上与稠密候选生成相当，同时还能提供精确的解释。
tldr: 该论文提出用“决策列”（决策模型对自然语言问题给出的“是/否/未提及”校准答案）构建可解释嵌入，使相似度可精确分解为逐问题贡献、支持语义过滤与增量扩展，并在产品基准上取得与稠密嵌入相当的实体匹配效果，同时提供精确可审计的解释。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes interpretable embeddings built from decision columns—calibrated yes/no/not-stated answers of decision models to natural-language questions—enabling exact per-question decomposition of similarity, semantic filtering, and incremental extension, while matching dense candidate generation on product benchmarks and providing exact, auditable explanations.
